title: RESEARCH ON THE TYPES OF FUTURE TEACHERS’ SELF-REALISATION UNDER CONDITIONS OF A DIGITAL EDUCATIONAL ENVIRONMENT
reason: Psychological typology of future teachers' self-realisation from anonymous Google-form questionnaires (Personal Orientation Inventory and others), with Spearman correlations and k-means clustering. All data self-report; no digital-environment indicator or activity product is analysed.

extraction.country: Ukraine (Kherson State University; Ivan Franko National University of Lviv)
extraction.design: cross-sectional survey, correlation and cluster analysis
extraction.population: final-year Bachelor's and Master's pedagogy students, 2 universities
extraction.outcome_or_construct: self-realisation types, time competence, value orientations, motivation (self-report)
extraction.notes: Text is readable but the PDF font encoding drops some digits: the sample size reads 'n 29 individuals: females (n 22 6.7) and males (n 4 1.1)', so n is not recoverable from the text layer. Studying in a digital environment is the context, not a measured indicator.
